title: Orders per customer including zero
statementMd:
Show every customer and how many orders they placed (zero if none).

Expected columns: `name`, `orders`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Count a column from the right table, not `*`.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS orders FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
